assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent dizziness that have significantly impacted daily activities.
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiogram is ordered to capture cardiac rhythm during symptomatic periods.
The study is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study.
The CPT code for the study is 93226.
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary to correlate the reported episodes with cardiac rhythm findings.
